turn.text:
Some users can't open new connections at peak times, others are fine. Investigate the firewall NAT and fix it.

Site notes: the firewall is `fw` (ssh fw). conntrack is installed.
Diagnosis: this is NAT port/pool exhaustion under load - the SNAT port range is too small for the connection volume.
Plan: ssh h1 'nc -zv -w 3 198.51.100.10 9000'; conntrack -S | grep -o 'insert_failed=[0-9]*' | sort -u; nft list chain ip nat postrouting; sed -i 's#meta l4proto tcp snat to 203.0.113.2:40000-40019#snat to 203.0.113.2#' /etc/nftables.conf; fw-commit

result.output: nc: connect to 198.51.100.10 port 9000 (tcp) timed out: Operation now in progress
